A [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|sow]] acted as the '''wife''' of [[Jubnuk/Legends|Jubnuk]], one of the nine Gamorrean guards employed by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] at his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. She also acted as the mother to some children. On what was ultimately Jubnuk's [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|last day]] under the employment of Jabba, he left for work and bid his wife and children goodbye while they were playing [[Droids and guards]].
